units.source_text: 那时候，不能说我没有勇气。

en.t: At that time, it could not be said that I lacked courage.
I understood the courage of one who confesses!

units.source_text: 二十年来我缄口不言地生活过来，我懂得坦白的价值。

en.t: For twenty years I had lived with my mouth shut, and I understood the value of confession.
Could it really be said that I had gone too far?

units.source_text: 我对抗老师的无言而坚持不坦白，或许是为了试一试"行恶可能吗"。

en.t: Perhaps I resisted the teacher's silence and persisted in not confessing in order to test whether doing evil was possible.

units.source_text: 如果我坚持到最后也不忏悔，行恶就已经成为可能，哪怕只是小小的行恶。

en.t: If I held out to the very end and still did not repent, then doing evil would already have become possible, even if it was only a tiny evil.
